say:0:1810520001:0.text: Time passes. The moonlight outside the hut grows brighter, filtering through the gaps between the giant bones and spilling into the room.
say:0:1810520001:0.source_cn: 时间流逝，骨屋外的月色渐渐变得明亮，透过巨骨之间的缝隙...

say:2:1810520002:0.text: Thane glances at the sky, his expression gradually turning serious.
say:2:1810520002:0.source_cn: 瑟恩向窗外望了一眼，神情逐渐严肃。

say:3:1810520003:0.text: The <style="highlight">full moon</style> is almost here. Baden and Estrilda haven't returned yet.

say:7:1810520005:1.text: ... Knowing those two, once they start having fun, they tend to forget about everything else.
say:7:1810520005:1.source_cn: ……以他们兄妹俩的性格，一旦高兴过头，就会忘记一些要事。

say:8:1810520006:1.text: Baden might have shown some restraint before he lost his memories. But the Baden now... I wouldn't count on it.
say:8:1810520006:1.source_cn: 如果是失忆前的巴登，可能还会有所收敛。但现在的巴登……...

say:9:1810520007:1.text: Rain would never forget my warnings! If he's not back yet, he must have run into danger.
say:9:1810520007:1.source_cn: 里纳不可能忘记老身的嘱咐！此刻还没回来，只怕已经遇上了危险。

say:10:1810520008:1.text: No, this won't do. I have to find them! We must bring them back before the <style="highlight">full moon</style> rises!
say:10:1810520008:1.source_cn: 不行，老身得去找他们！务必要赶在<style=high...

say:11:1810520009:1.text: Let's split up. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will search the outskirts of the village.
say:11:1810520009:1.male: Let's split up. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will search the outskirts of the village.
say:11:1810520009:1.female: Let's split up. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I will search the outskirts of the village.

say:12:1810520010:1.text: If you find them, make sure they stay inside the Bone Hut. Especially Ba... Rain.
say:12:1810520010:1.source_cn: 如果你先找到他们，务必让他们在骨屋内待好，尤其是巴……里纳。

say:13:1810520011:1.text: If necessary, have Estrilda pin him down and knock him unconscious. Otherwise, he'll absolutely run off trying to find someone again.
say:13:1810520011:1.source_cn: 让爱丝按住他，把他揍晕过去也行。否则，他绝对又会不顾一...

choice:6:0:1.text: Trying to help Baden regain his memories.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 去试着找回巴登的记忆
choice:6:0:1.male: Trying to help Baden regain his memories.
choice:6:0:1.female: Trying to help Baden regain his memories.
